title: TP2 config
description: TP2 configuration properties for the algorithms' hyperparameters

select.description: How many individuals the method selects (K). Must be even, since the breeding step pairs them up

generation.description: A generation counter, passed along to the algorithms with the updated value. Boltzmann selection reads it to cool its temperature down

roulette.description: The roulette (fitness proportionate) selection algorithm configurations

universal.description: The universal (stochastic universal sampling) selection algorithm configurations

t0.description: Initial temperature. Higher means a flatter, more explorative distribution at generation 0

tc.description: Asymptotic temperature the schedule cools down to. Lower means a more elitist endgame

k.description: Cooling rate of T(t) = tc + (t0 - tc) * exp(-k * t)

deterministic_tournament.description: The deterministic tournament selection algorithm configurations

m.description: Tournament size. 1 is no selection pressure, the population size converges to elite

probabilistic_tournament.description: The probabilistic tournament selection algorithm configurations

threshold.description: Probability of the fitter individual winning a duel. 0.5 is a coin flip, 1 is a deterministic tournament with m = 2
